fact: At the groundbreaking on 20 August 2024 the Vice President said 28 new police stations would take the total from 83 to 111 within a year, and the Minister of Defence and Security said each would be delivered with information technology and radio communication under a turnkey contract of P1.665 billion financed by two local developers and repaid by government over 24 months; the report names no records system.
title: Construction of police stations commences
